results.title: Project health (CHAOSS)
results.description: How active and widely carried the project is: the bus factor, the spread over organisations, how change requests and issues are handled, and how often it releases. Informative: shown, not rated.
results.message: 6 of 6 CHAOSS metrics measured. They are shown for information and do not count in any rating.

metrics.name: Contributor Absence Factor
metrics.explanation: The fewest people who together made half of the commits on the default branch in the last 12 months, of the 100 contributors GitHub reports, among 18 human contributors. At 1 the project depends on a single person. Bots are left out; one person with several accounts or addresses counts more than once.

metrics.name: Organizational Diversity
metrics.explanation: Organisations are told apart by the email domain of the latest 300 commits of the last 12 months (152 commits by people, after the .mailmap) and, for a personal or hidden address, by the company on the author's public profile. The largest is sanderboer.nl (3 authors), with 94% of the 110 commits whose organisation is known; 28% of the commits come from 3 of 8 authors whose organisation stays unknown. Only these counts are kept, no names, addresses or companies; an organisation is named only when several authors share it.

metrics.name: Change Request Closure Ratio
metrics.explanation: 1,088 change requests were closed (merged or not) and 1,099 opened in the last 90 days, bots included. Below 1 the open backlog grows; above 1 it shrinks.

metrics.name: Time to First Response
metrics.explanation: The median time to the first comment or review by someone other than the author, over the 15 latest change requests opened by people between 2026-08-22 and 2026-11-13. 15 got a response; 0 had none yet. Bots are left out.

metrics.name: Issue Response Time
metrics.explanation: The median time to the first comment by someone other than the author, over the 2 latest issues opened by people between 2026-08-22 and 2026-11-13. 1 got a response; 1 had none yet. Bots are left out.

metrics.name: Release Frequency
metrics.explanation: 38 final releases were published in the last 12 months, about one every 10 days, counted from the GitHub releases. The latest final release is from 2026-11-11. Besides these, 1 pre-releases were published; they are not counted. Drafts and pre-releases are left out.

notes: Measured over the open issues and the issues closed in the last 90 days, in working days (Monday to Friday, Europe/Amsterdam, without Dutch public holidays).

Vulnerabilities are read from the published GitHub security advisories, from draft to publication. Their response time, unpublished advisories and Dependabot alerts need admin rights and are not measured.
